strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal weak-network VPN for OpenWrt/Linux to Linux or Windows using unordered FakeTCP/FEC carriers plus a native standards-compliant DTLS 1.3 WBD security/session layer. Xray/VLESS/Vision/REALITY, WireGuard and Android are not part of the V2.1 product stack.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: V2-M3 native WBD session/control inside the locally qualified one-lane DTLS/FEC/FakeTCP path; M3A framing, M3B token auth and M3C liveness/stats passed, M3D reconnect policy active
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Keep all M3 semantics inside an already-finished DTLS 1.3 association. Do not invent another cryptographic layer, reliable public byte stream or custom FEC. Do not start two-lane, kernel-anchor, TUN/L3, Windows, Auto or detector-specific shaping work before the M3 session/control gate passes. M3D may define close/reconnect semantics and deterministic policy only; it must not silently replay application data.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed V2-M3C through substantive commit 8f6b49b4e748e867a36a20a5fb845892a73fcf4e. The carrier-agnostic control codec adds fixed 8-byte PING/PONG nonce bodies. ServerSession accepts PING only in Established and echoes the exact nonce in PONG; pre-HELLO or pre-auth liveness is rejected. HandleWire performs strict decode/encode while tracking real control RX/TX messages and encoded byte counts, auth-required/authenticated state, ping/pong counts and caller-supplied last-activity tick without exposing token contents. IdleExpired(now,idle) is a pure caller-driven monotonic-tick helper: idle=0 disables expiry, clock regression does not expire, and the exact now-last_activity==idle boundary is expired; it creates no timer and retransmits nothing. Local direct-DTLS authority used the M2-qualified quiet shim SHA-256 63329b8528196159f430bb89bf40b98e52ed74073f57ed81d068cddb55e50d7a. Both auth-disabled and token-authenticated sessions started control only after DTLSv1.3 READY, established successfully, then completed PING->PONG with identical nonces. Server stats recorded pings=1, pongs=1 and correct auth flags/wire bytes. Accepted local source SHA-256 identities: control.go 8be3e703eb46293ef8909633cef254edf6567443f4ee5092d1cc6d5010048778, control_test.go d14f5e579e4892eada6f636c05be675b1c215d93061865b2abbf6ecb019f92ad, probe f0d1e32618083cf7f42983ba777ec006cf4f758d47d0336eb43d57df0b51df5d, qualification script cc530f8b75340e22d835bef4a7fd158253f81214b49e32df25bcc385a019c706, receipt 8c3309eed743c054f4995dfac2173f95149c29d076eeaa7e2fc7453f9d3c82fd and doc 283ada9fa272879dde304aef5b15f4de56f5669ee2d40b0b7228dd42baa52c75. GitHub ci, handoff-verify and build-quic-oracle all completed successfully for 8f6b49b4e748e867a36a20a5fb845892a73fcf4e.
continuation_cursor.current_task: V2-M3D: define explicit session termination and reconnect eligibility without implementing a hidden reliability layer. Add a bounded CLOSE control message with reason codes, make Established sessions transition to Closed on peer CLOSE or local idle expiry, and define a deterministic reconnect/backoff policy helper for callers.
continuation_cursor.why_now: M3 now has strict framing, authorization and liveness/accounting. The remaining session-control gap before the M3 gate can close is deterministic behavior when a DTLS/session ends. Explicit close reasons and caller-driven reconnect policy prevent ad-hoc reconnect loops from being mixed later with TUN or carrier loss handling.
continuation_cursor.done_when: M3D defines strict CLOSE framing with bounded UTF-8 detail and enumerated reasons for normal, idle-timeout, auth/policy failure and protocol error; a session can enter Closed explicitly and exposes the close reason in stats without storing credentials; reconnect eligibility distinguishes normal/policy/auth/protocol close from transient/idle transport loss; a pure backoff helper returns bounded deterministic delays from attempt number and configured min/max with no goroutine or sleeping; unit tests cover CLOSE encoding/malformed cases, state transitions, retry/no-retry reason mapping and backoff boundaries/overflow; and a direct-DTLS loopback demonstrates Established -> PING/PONG -> CLOSE with a recorded reason. No application-data replay or TUN work is part of M3D.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: V2-M3D: add a bounded CLOSE frame (reason code plus <=256-byte UTF-8 detail), a Closed session state and close-reason stats. Define pure ReconnectAllowed(reason) and Backoff(attempt,min,max) helpers with saturating bounds. Write table-driven codec/state/policy tests first. Then extend the direct DTLS probe to establish, PING/PONG once and send/receive one CLOSE reason. Do not implement an automatic reconnect loop, application-data replay or TUN yet.
